tidinmenu.title: Functions
tidinmenu.hint: Press Ctrl again or Esc to close　·　Rebind in Options → Key Binds
tidinmenu.tool.spin.tip:
Spins the player around their own vertical (Y) axis.
View, third-person model and the rotation synced to the server all turn together.
Only the facing changes, never the position - no teleporting, no wall clipping.
Exclusive with "Model Spin" and "Airplane Spin"; shares speed and direction. Stops on death or leaving the world.
tidinmenu.tool.spin_model.tip:
Spins only the character model (body and head) around the vertical (Y) axis; the camera view does NOT turn.
First-person stays rock steady - press F5 to watch the model spin.
WASD, attacking and block placing still follow the (unchanged) view; it is client-side only, other players cannot see it.
Exclusive with "Spin" and "Airplane Spin"; shares speed and direction. The model returns to face your view when stopped.
tidinmenu.tool.spin_airplane.tip:
Spins exactly like "Model Spin" (only the character model turns around the Y axis, the view stays still)
while holding both arms of the character model straight out horizontally - left arm to the left,
right arm to the right - airplane pose.
Press F5 to watch the arms-out spin in third person; first-person view is untouched.
WASD, attacking and block placing still follow the (unchanged) view.
Exclusive with "Spin" and "Model Spin"; shares speed and direction. Arms drop and the model re-aligns to your view when stopped.
tidinmenu.tool.spin_speed.tip:
Click to cycle: Slow 60 deg/s -> Normal 180 deg/s -> Fast 360 deg/s -> Ultra 720 deg/s.
Applies instantly, to Spin, Model Spin and Airplane Spin alike.
tidinmenu.tool.spin_dir.tip:
Clockwise turns to the right, counter-clockwise to the left (seen from above).
In Spin mode WASD follows the rotating view; in Model Spin the view never moves.
tidinmenu.spin.badge_model_hint: View stays still - press F5 to watch - Ctrl to stop
tidinmenu.spin.badge_airplane_hint: Arms out - view stays still - Ctrl again to stop
tidinmenu.spin.badge_hint: Press Ctrl again to open the menu and stop
tidinmenu.tool.hide_model.tip:
In third person (F5) your whole character model becomes invisible: body, armor, cape and held items all vanish.
First-person is untouched; you are hidden only from yourself - other players still see you normally (client-side only).
Stacks freely with the spins (hidden + airplane spin = an invisible spinning you). The model reappears instantly when turned off.
tidinmenu.hide.badge_hint: Hidden from you only - press F5 to check - Ctrl again to show
tidinmenu.tool.sit_pose.tip:
In third person (F5) your character model sits cross-legged: legs folded and crossed in front of the body, torso resting on them with a slight forward lean, hands toward the knees, whole model lowered to sitting height (head at ~71% of standing height).
View, movement and hitbox are untouched - client-side only, other players still see you standing; sleeves and trouser legs follow automatically.
Stacks with the spins (sit and spin); with Airplane Spin also on, the sitting hand placement wins. Pauses on death, sleep, elytra and riding; turns off when you leave the world.
tidinmenu.sit.badge_hint: Press F5 to look - Ctrl again to stand up
tidinmenu.tool.auto_fish.tip:
While holding a fishing rod, the mod scans for the fishing bar and pointer (white core, dark blue-gray outline, double arrows clamping the bar).
Supports any green layout in bar1..bar9; bar10's all-teal variant is excluded. The right-click fires only when the pointer edge truly touches a green zone (tolerance ~3 texture columns); a sweep check still catches fast passes between two samples.
Bite hook: when the on-screen subtitle "Bobber splashes" appears (the bobber splash sound), the mod right-clicks to hook the bite. It only fires while the bobber is in the water and the fishing bar is off-screen, and exactly once per bite; the sound source must be near your own bobber or near you, so other players' splashes don't trigger it. This works even with the subtitles option turned off.
Auto-recast only happens after the bar has been recognized at least once and disappeared for ~1 s; if the bar was never recognized, no right-click is ever sent, so it cannot interrupt the minigame.
The upper-right counters show scans, bars recognized, brightness (percent of non-black sampled pixels of the read frame), green hits, right-clicks and splash heard/fired. Brightness stuck at 0 means this device returns black frames from the main framebuffer; the mod then automatically switches to reading the window back buffer. Turns off when you leave the world.
tidinmenu.autofish.badge_hint: Hooks on bobber splash - reels in on green - Ctrl again to stop
tidinmenu.autofish.badge_stats: Scans %1$s - bars %2$s - bright %3$s%% - green %4$s - clicks %5$s - splash %6$s/%7$s
tidinmenu.tool.r6_model.tip:
Adjusts the local player model to match the classic Roblox blocky reference:
body width/depth x1.77; arms width/depth x1.84; legs width/depth x1.75; head width/depth x1.35 and height x1.20. Body and limb lengths remain unchanged.
Arm pivots move inward so sleeves slightly overlap the torso and avoid visible gaps; legs align at the crotch.
Sleeves, trousers, jacket and hat follow; held items keep their normal size.
Only affects your own third-person model (F5); turning it off explicitly restores vanilla proportions. Height, movement and hitbox are unchanged.
tidinmenu.r6.badge_hint: Press F5 to look - Ctrl again to restore
tidinmenu.setting.desc: Everything uses recommended values; no config file needed.
